references.description: References to rows that do not exist after the restore, cleared or moved to the restoring admin

table.description: The table of the row that holds the reference.

id.description: The id of that row; null for a link row.

column.description: * when a link row is removed

to.description: What it becomes: null when the link is cleared, or the restoring administrator's id for an owner.

label.description: The row that holds the reference, as it is called in lists.

skippedUsers.description: Backup users that are not restored because they are the restoring admin

id.description: The user's id in the backup.

missingSecrets.description: Chosen types whose secrets the backup does not hold
